title: ClearPath Tenure Discount on Onsite Visit Labor
content:
The tenure visit discount on the onsite visit labor of a ClearPath Managed IT Services ticket counts the whole months from the agreement's go-live date to today.

| Whole months from go-live to today | Discount on the visit labor |
|---|---|
| 24 or more | 5.0 percent off |
| 12 to 23 | 2.5 percent off |
| fewer than 12 | nothing |

A whole month between two dates is counted only once the later date reaches the same day of the month as the earlier one, and a month window of N months ending today takes the entries dated fewer than N whole months before today.

**Hypothetical cases.** Go-live 2023-09-15: on 2025-09-14 the agreement has 23 whole months, 2.5 percent off; on 2025-09-15 it has 24, 5.0 percent off. Go-live 2025-02-01: on 2025-12-20 it has 10 whole months, nothing off.
